INSERT INTO news (title, slug, excerpt, date, location, status, featured, published_at, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES 
('Making My SCR Debut: Million Dollar Quartet (2025)', 'million-dollar-quartet-scr-debut', 'Co-designing my first production at South Coast Repertory, one of the nation''s leading regional theaters.', '2025-08-29', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-29', NOW(), NOW()),
('Assisting Tom Buderwitz on The Play That Goes Wrong at Seattle Rep', 'assisting-the-play-that-goes-wrong', 'Working with Tom Buderwitz on this hilarious comedy at Seattle Repertory Theatre.', '2025-08-28', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-28', NOW(), NOW()),
('40 Productions at Okoboji Summer Theatre', '40-productions-at-okoboji-summer-theatre', 'Celebrating a milestone: my 40th scenic design for Okoboji Summer Theatre.', '2025-08-06', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-06', NOW(), NOW()),
('Opening Night: Deathtrap at Okoboji Summer Theatre', 'deathtrap-opening-ost', 'Ira Levin''s clever thriller opens at OST.', '2025-08-01', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-01', NOW(), NOW()),
('Fifth Season Assisting Jo Winiarski — Utah Shakespeare Festival', 'fifth-season-utah-shakespeare-festival', 'Returning for my fifth season as assistant scenic designer at Utah Shakespeare Festival.', '2025-06-27', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-06-27', NOW(), NOW()),
('My Season as Scenic Designer for New Swan Shakespeare Festival (2025)', 'new-swan-season-2025', 'Designing two Shakespeare productions for New Swan''s outdoor amphitheater.', '2025-06-01', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-06-01', NOW(), NOW()),
('Opening Night: Romero at University of Missouri', 'romero-opening-university-of-missouri', 'World premiere production exploring the life and martyrdom of Archbishop Óscar Romero.', '2025-04-23', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-04-23', NOW(), NOW()),
('Scenic Design for Okoboji Summer Theatre — Summer 2025 Season', 'okoboji-summer-2025-season', 'Announcing my designs for the 2025 summer season at Okoboji Summer Theatre.', '2025-04-16', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-04-16', NOW(), NOW()),
('Joining United Scenic Artists, Local USA 829', 'united-scenic-artists-local-usa-829', 'Officially joining the union for professional scenic, lighting, and costume designers.', '2024-04-30', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2024-04-30', NOW(), NOW()),
('2024 Okoboji Summer Theatre Season – Scenic Designs Announced', 'okoboji-summer-2024-season', 'Season announcement for summer 2024 at Okoboji Summer Theatre.', '2023-06-02', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2023-06-02', NOW(), NOW());

-- Import articles
INSERT INTO articles (title, slug, excerpt, content, readTime, status, featured, authorId, publishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
VALUES

('Building a Scenic Design Portfolio That Gets You Hired', 'building-scenic-design-portfolio', 'Practical advice on creating a compelling portfolio that showcases your work effectively.', 'Practical advice on creating a compelling portfolio that showcases your work effectively.', 8, 'published', FALSE, 1, '2025-08-15', NOW(), NOW()),
